E.  NEW BUSINESS

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that a low cost mobile dog and
cat vaccine clinic will be held on Tuesday, March 12, 2024.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, provided an update on Vote Centers for the March 5, 2024, Presidential
Primary Election.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced a block clean up on Saturday, March 9, 2024.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa asked how a resident can request to participate in the parade.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula thanked parents and stakeholders who attended the recent ABCUSD town
hall meetings and reported that our school will remain open.

Mayor Farfan thanked the families and children who spoke and advocated for our schools.

Councilmember Roa was very impressed by how the community came together to support our local
schools; and thanked Mariana Rios for representing the city on the committee.

Councilmember Vargas requested that residents continue to go to school meetings to support the
schools.

Mayor Pro Tem De Paula was thankful that the Hawaiian Gardens ABCUSD town hall meetings
provided childcare and transportation for residents.

J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:48 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, March 13, 2024 at 6:00 PM.
